leaderboard.note: ⭐ THE DIRECT-LEARNED FOIL — the shipped E7.12-slice-1 configuration with NO ladder
PLUMBING IDENTITY — rung maps forced to 0 + 1·x, so this must be a BYTE no-op vs L0. A gap here means the ladder code path itself perturbs the fit and every arm is confounded.

⭐ MATCHED LEVEL-ONLY FOIL (NF-D15 g′) — per-rung ADDITIVE mean shift, slope pinned to 1. It keeps the level scale and strips every per-player content. If it ties the fitted ladder, the ladder's stated mechanism is refuted and what happened is level re-centring.
⭐ one-step (level → Triple-A) maps — avoids the chain's THREEFOLD attenuation compounding
REGISTERED SENSITIVITY — L1 with every transition that had not FINISHED before the held-out cohort purged. Settles the calendar-leakage question by measurement instead of argument.
⭐ NESTS THE FOIL — the raw line is kept and the ladder DELTA enters as a fixed regressor, so a win is unambiguously 'the ladder adds information beyond the raw line'
composed adjacent-rung OLS maps, unweighted (the matched pair for L2's weighting)
the same chain with rung regressions weighted by the pair's harmonic-mean line length
LINK ANCHOR — rung maps fit with the DESTINATION rates permuted within rung. Both marginals survive; only the within-player pairing dies. Must LOSE.
DEGENERATE CEILING (NF-D11/NF-D14) — predict the population mean of the target. A real candidate losing to this means the selection metric is inverted.

reasons: 🟡 no arm clears: best eligible `L3_direct_to_ref` MAE 0.02880 vs foil 0.02879 (-0.04%, fold win rate 45%; the pre-registered bar is a strict OOS improvement in ≥60% of folds). DROPPED.

reasons: ⛔ DEFLATION — PBO over the ELIGIBLE set is 0.514 ≥ 0.2. ⭐ READ IT AS A **TIE**, NOT AS OVERFITTING: the contender spread is 0.355% and the in-sample halves split across arms that are a fraction of a percent apart (L1p_chain_purged 45% (+0.000%), L4_ladder_delta 27% (+0.476%), L1_chain_ols 13% (+0.362%)). Which tied arm wins is noise — which is exactly what a trustworthy learner-null looks like (E2.1-r). The honest record is 'no ladder formulation robustly beats the shipped configuration', so the shipped configuration is now PROVEN rather than assumed. Either way it does not ship.
